subject: Avalon Health demo — onboarding pre-reqs and scheduling
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@avalonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Avalon Health — demo on May 20 & onboarding checklist

Hi Alicia,

Looking forward to the demo we penciled in for Wednesday, May 20 at 10am PT. Before we run a live walkthrough, your procurement/security team asked us to confirm a couple of onboarding items so the session can include your engineering and security folks:

- Signed NDA (we received a draft from procurement last week — attaching for reference).
- Completed vendor intake / security questionnaire (procurement indicated this is required for any live demo with customer data or architecture discussion).
- SOC2 summary or attestation (we can share our SOC2 summary and auditor contact if helpful).

If any of these items will take longer than a week, happy to push the live demo and instead send a short pre-recorded walkthrough to keep momentum.

Can you confirm expected timing from your side? If you prefer, we can also run a short internal security call with your team prior to the demo to walk through controls.

Thanks — I cc'd procurement to keep intake visible.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Avalon_NDA_20260512.pdf (pdf)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@avalonhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Wells <ethan.wells@avalonhealth.com>, procurement@avalonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Avalon Health — demo on May 20 & onboarding checklist

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the note. Quick update from procurement/security side: 

- Legal needs the NDA signed before any exec-level architecture discussion. Our legal team flagged a couple of redlines in the version you sent; they will route edits back to you.
- Our vendor intake questionnaire must be completed by the vendor and validated by our InfoSec team before we invite the engineering team to a live demo. That can take ~5–10 business days depending on the responses.
- Our CISO (Ethan) will be traveling the week of May 18 and won't be available on May 20. Given both the travel conflict and the intake gating, can we please pause the live demo until the intake is done and NDA is agreed?

In the meantime, would you be able to share a redacted SOC2 summary and a short recording of the product (screen + narration) so the execs can review asynchronously? That would help us keep the deal moving.

Appreciate it — I will loop in procurement and legal on the NDA exchange.

— Alicia
Alicia Ramos | Head of Platform Partnerships
Avalon Health
Alicia.Ramos@avalonhealth.com

Thanks Alicia — totally understand. We can pause the live session while procurement/legal finish the NDA and intake. A few notes and options from our side:

1) Documents: I attached a short SOC2 summary and a link to our compliance pack for your InfoSec reviewers (see attachments/HubSpot link). If legal needs a full report we can coordinate a secure share.

2) Interim content: I can send a 12-minute narrated product walkthrough by EOD today so execs can see the product while your team completes intake.

3) Reschedule windows: how does the week of June 1 look for you? We have open slots Tue 6/1, Wed 6/2, and Thu 6/3 (morning PT). If you prefer, we can lock a tentative hold and update after intake is completed.

4) Demo scope: if procurement will sign NDA quickly, we can run a limited demo that avoids customer-specific data and focuses on architecture and throughput/cost characteristics. If NDA/attestation are delayed, we'll plan the full demo after intake completes.

Next steps: I'll send the narrated walkthrough today and propose tentative holds for 6/2 and 6/3. Please let me know your preferred date and any legal points we should be aware of.

Best,
Stephanie

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Avalon Health — procurement gating / suggested plan

Internal — quick sync. Avalon Procurement is asking for: signed NDA + completed vendor questionnaire + SOC2 summary before inviting engineering to the live demo. CISO is traveling week of 5/18 so they asked to pause May 20.

Recommendation:
- We provide the SOC2 summary and a short recorded demo immediately (already sending).
- Legal: agree to a modest NDA redline tolerance (no customer data requested, timing-sensitive). Markus, can you coordinate legal/AE to accept reasonable redlines within 48 hours?
- Intake: we can offer to fill the vendor questionnaire ourselves but need to confirm product-owner time to answer technical controls (Monica?).
- Escalation: if procurement pushes beyond 2 weeks, offer a pre-recorded technical deep-dive and an optional 30-min security-only call with one of our security engineers.

Please confirm and I will reply to Alicia with a proposed reschedule (target: week of 6/1).

— Steph

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Demo reschedule & next steps (proposed new date: week of June 1)

Hi Alicia / Ethan — following up after our internal review. Thanks for flagging the intake gating and Ethan's travel. To keep things moving, here is what we propose: 

1) Tentative live demo: Thursday, June 3 at 10:00am PT (please confirm — we'll hold the slot for now).
2) NDA timing: please aim to return the signed NDA or comments by Friday, May 28 so legal has time to review. If procurement prefers, we can accept a DocuSign signature to expedite.
3) Vendor intake: we will complete the vendor questionnaire on our side and submit it to procurement by Monday, May 31 — Monica will coordinate answers to the technical controls. 
4) Interim asset: attached is a 12-minute narrated walkthrough (no customer data) that you can circulate to execs today while intake completes.
5) Security call: if InfoSec wants a focused call, we can schedule a 30-min security review the week of May 25 — let us know preferred times.

Next steps for Avalon: confirm whether 6/3 10am PT works, return NDA by 5/28, and advise if you want the security-only call. If procurement/legal prefer a different cadence, we can adapt.

Thanks again — we'll keep the hold in place and will cancel if you prefer another date.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
